title: Expired Milk
description: This mod is created by @TheEpitex youtube channel. Milk expires after a while.
body:
This mod is created by @TheEpitex Youtube channel.
Milk buckets now have an expiration date. If you keep a milk bucket in your inventory or a chest for too long, it will spoil. Drinking expired milk will give you Poison and Nausea effects instead of clearing status effects.
